title: feat(app-shell): page-mode record create/edit routes (`editMode: 'page'`)
body:
### CI fixes (this session, on top of editMode page work)

- [x] Identify CI failures
- [x] `@object-ui/types` — re-export `CreateExportJobRequest`, `ExportJobProgressInfo`, `ExportJobStatus`, `ExportJobFormat`, `CreateExportJobResult` from the package barrel (referenced by `@object-ui/components/src/hooks/use-export-job.ts`)
- [x] `@object-ui/app-shell` — `ConsoleFloatingChatbot` `preferred && agents.find(...)` was inferred as `'' | AgentDescriptor` and broke `tsc` on `.name`; switch to ternary so `match` is `AgentDescriptor | undefined`
- [x] `@object-ui/plugin-report` — `ReportViewer` test compared `backgroundColor` to a hex string but jsdom normalizes to `rgb(...)`; assert against normalized form
- [x] Re-run `turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'` (39/39 ✅) and `turbo run test --concurrency=4` (70/70 ✅)
- [x] Address code-review style nits (Tailwind class order, drop `as string[]` cast, trim trailing blank line)

### Original PR

Page-mode record create/edit routes (`editMode: 'page'`) — already merged into the branch.
